policy_presence.summary: Official generative AI guidance and scope boundaries for University of Zurich are retained in local candidate evidence pending independent presentation review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Always indicate generative AI use; declaration examples are adaptable, not one mandatory campus form.

coursework.summary: Module staff determine assessment AI permissions; check course syllabus before use.

exams.summary: Assessments may permit, restrict or exclude AI; fair conditions should be provided.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Observe data-protection law and Copilot-specific data classes. Secret data cannot be used in either version.

academic_integrity.summary: UZH disciplinary rules apply; the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences has module-specific misconduct guidance.

approved_tools.summary: Basic Copilot is free for members; Premium is employee-only paid access, not assessment approval.

named_ai_services.summary: Named AI services for University of Zurich are retained as discovery records pending independent presentation review; service availability does not grant assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: Course staff cannot compel paid GenAI or tools requiring personal registration data.

research_guidance.summary: Disclose generative tools in research methods and follow publisher/journal policies. Thesis-specific rules are not established.

security_procurement.summary: Use protected institutional Copilot with UZH account; Premium licensing depends on organizational enablement.
